reading.notes: Vinyl label for Side D with a large red and white 'F' logo. No clear tracklist is printed. Only faint, partly cut-off grey background text is visible, such as 'FEELS LIK...', 'KNOW WHAT LOVE I...', 'HOT BLOODE...' and 'BOX HE...', which is too fragmentary to use as track titles. The red rim carries small print including a 2025 copyright line (Trooper Productions, under exclusive license to earMUSIC), 'Made in Germany by optimal media GmbH', and GEMA/BIEM. A partly legible number (possibly 0269...) and 'LC-35916' also appear, but they are too small to read reliably, so no barcode or catalog number is given.
